_comment: Office contact details, copied by hand from each institution's own website, with the page and the date it was collected. Entries collected 2026-11-12 come from contact pages in the crawl (data/crawl/db/); entries collected 2026-11-25 were read from the live site because the crawl had not captured them. Only what the page states plainly is here: a blank or placeholder field on the page is left out, numbers belonging to a named official or a branch are not used, and Khmer digits are written as Latin digits so the number can be dialled (the note says so). Short four-digit hotlines (e.g. 1275) are kept as the page gives them. Not reviewed by a content steward, and shown that way. Not yet confirmed by phone: see docs/report-3/contact-call-sheet.md. Shown on a source card when the cited page is on the same website (lib/kb/contacts.ts). Re-check against the source page when the crawl is refreshed.
